# Clipchamp

Generated from [tokens.json](tokens.json) and [README.md](README.md) by the design-systems catalog tool. Do not edit this file: change the tokens through the package's builders, then run `make design-md` at the repository root.

It follows the DESIGN.md spec, version alpha. That format has no themes, no per-value provenance and only px, em and rem units, so this file holds the `light` theme alone with every alias resolved. [tokens.json](tokens.json) is the source of truth: it records where each value was read, and keeps the 1 tokens from these groups that DESIGN.md cannot hold (gradients, shadows, percentages, durations and other non-colour or non-px values).

## Overview

Good for: Microsoft's video-editor marketing: a server-rendered React/Fluent-UI build carrying two declared token layers at once - the marketing --color-* ramps (purple brand, blue and pink accents, grey inks) and the full Fluent v9 set on .fui-FluentProvider themed to purple-80 #6453e4 - over a single light theme with #313242 dark bands, Segoe UI Variable type, 10px-radius buttons that scale 1.05 on hover, white-pill CTAs on purple bands and a Fluent sign-in card boundary.

Captured 2026-11-17, signed out (the marketing routes are fully public; the editor sits behind app.clipchamp.com sign-in - the public login card was measured at rest, the email path where the only field lives was never entered; consent and promo overlays were hidden without answering them; CTA anchors to signup/login were never followed). Themes: light.

A token set and component reference for Clipchamp's public surface — for building clean light marketing pages and a purple-accented control language in the style of the real thing. It was read from **clipchamp.com** on **2026-11-17**, signed out, in headless Chromium at 1440 x 900 and 390 x 844: the marketing routes (home, pricing, features, products, for-work, education, templates, company, blog, what's new, stock and the screen-recorder page), plus the public sign-in card on **app.clipchamp.com** as a boundary.

Clipchamp is worth a capture because Microsoft's video editor runs a server-rendered React build that carries **two declared token layers at once**: the marketing sheet's own `--color-*` ramps (a purple brand ramp, blue and pink accents, grey ink steps, link roles and social colours on `:root`) and a full **Fluent UI v9** layer on `.fui-FluentProvider` (colorBrand*/colorNeutral*, the borderRadius*/spacing*/duration*/curve*/shadow* scales, fontSize*/fontWeight*/lineHeight* steps, fontFamilyBase = Segoe UI) — with the Fluent brand slot already themed to Clipchamp purple (`colorBrandBackground` = purple-80 `#6453e4`). It paints a **single light theme**: white `#ffffff` ground, `#fbfbfc` off-white bands and `#313242` dark content bands inside it. The marketing face is `segoeVariableFont` (Segoe UI Variable); the sign-in app uses plain Segoe UI — two stacks, both measured. The signature micro-motion is a **1.05 hover scale with a 0.2s ease** on every button. **Boundary:** the editor itself, checkout and every OAuth/account action sit behind sign-in; the app.clipchamp.com/login card was measured at rest and the email path — where the only credentials field lives — was never crossed; nothing was typed, submitted or authenticated.

## Do's and Don'ts

- Do take values from [tokens.json](tokens.json) when you need another theme, a value's source, or a token this file leaves out.
- Do read [README.md](README.md) before relying on a value; it says what is known to be wrong.
- Don't read colours off the screenshots; they are 256-colour PNGs.
- Don't copy the product's logo, icons, illustrations or brand colours into something that ships. Borrow structure and proportions.
- Don't edit this file; it is regenerated from the tokens.
